'''Ean Ventor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. He and his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] [[Zollet Ventor|Zollet]] were simple archivists working in the [[Royal Library of Alderaan/Legends|Royal Library of Alderaan]], but they ended up winning the sympathy of the [[Noble/Legends|nobleman]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]]. Eventually, Organa took their son, [[Halagad Ventor]], beneath his wing, offering him a first-rate education. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] sent the Ventor spouses as their trusted representatives for the largest annual gathering of Alderaanian aristocrats, scientists, intellectuals, and philanthropists, which took place on the island of [[Okonomo]]. However, the genetics terrorist [[Zeta Magnus]] was present at the party, and he unleashed a [[hive virus]] that drove all attendees mad, prompting them to devour each other's flesh and organs. Ean Ventor and his wife [[Death/Legends|died]] in that gruesome incident, which was later known as the [[Okonomo Tragedy]].<ref name="swcw" />
